test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
With reference to rice cultivation, which pair(s) of state and type of crop is/are correctly matched?

I. Punjab – subsistence crop

II. Odisha – Commercial Crop
solution:
The correct answer is __**neither I nor II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Commercial crops** are those that** offer better returns** to farmers.
 
• **Subsistence crops** are those that are **farmed by farmers** for their own** personal and family consumption.**
 
• Being a tropical crop,** rice **thrives in **hot and muggy weather.**
 
• It is raised in regions that are **rain-fed and get a lot of rain every year.**
 
• It is an essential** Kharif crop **in India for this reason.
 
• This crop requires a** temperature of at least 25 degrees** Celsius and a minimum of **100 cm of rainfall.**
 
• When there is less rainfall in a location**, irrigation techniques** are utilized to promote development.
 
• In India, rice is still harvested via **conventional techniques.**
 
• While rice is a **subsistence crop in Orissa**, it is a **commercial crop in states like Punjab.**
